ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 35% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white/cream pixels (intensity >200) concentrated on the lateral lobes, contrasted against ~65% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (intensity <40) dominating the central peduncle and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs located on the distal halves of the lobes. Left lobe: elongated white patch extending from the mid-lobe to the lateral tip, showing jagged internal black pixel intrusions. Right lobe: broader, more fragmented white patch with a high density of small-scale dark mottling along its inferior boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees; notch vertex is well-defined and centered on the vertical axis of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels; edge exhibits significant jaggedness particularly on the outer distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the proximal trailing edge transitioning to a sharp, slightly tapered distal point on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple low-intensity (black) pixel clusters or spots (diameter 5-20 pixels) distributed within the high-intensity white patches, most notably on the right lobe, consistent with focal pigmentation or historical colonization sites.
